Title: Canonical Japanese message inventory
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Every referenced text ID accounted for; dump→encode→dump round-trip byte-exact with untouched original; orphan/invalid references reported.

Title: English translation and editorial policy
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: 100% of reachable N64 Japanese text reviewed by context, with gloss, EN final text, reviewer and proof; intentional untranslated labels documented.

Title: Message control commands and conditional flow
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Identical control semantics for each translated message; no malformed control bytes, wrong branches or dialogue softlocks; first-time vs repeat paths tested. Fix/regression: explicit control-code schema, bounded encoder/decoder, message index/offset validator, font-width layout tests, and smoke-test all classes of scripted conversations. Track exact message IDs rather than inventing visible English text.

Title: English font, wrapping and dialog layouts
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: No clipping or unreadable glyphs at max legal names and longest messages; rendering stays within stock RAM/frame budgets.

Title: English keyboard and text entry
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Round-trip each input type through save/RTC/reset; reject invalid bytes cleanly; four residents retain distinct names, diaries and letters.

Title: Dynamic names, grammar and variable injection
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Max-length substitutions and nested variable messages render correctly for all four human residents; no wrong item/person name or overflow.

Title: English Animalese and speech timing
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Spoken text aligns with printed text, punctuation/pause speed and mute behavior; no audio underruns; real N64 verified; documented fallback if direct GC-style method is infeasible.

Title: Japanese-to-English letter tokenizer and policy
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Deterministic test corpus of meaningful/garbage/empty/long letters; stable, explainable scores; all four residents and attachments respected.

Title: Bounds-safe English trigram scoring
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Unit test every 26^3 three-letter combination plus fuzzed nonletters; no read outside table under ASAN/native test harness; exact expected scores; stable under different RAM contents.

Title: Villager-request letter quests and gift categories
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Regular and quest scoring are separate; test 0–2 versus ≥3 words, repeated characters, attachment yes/no, quest expiry/reset, each rank/category and inventory-full responses.

Title: Mail/post office, letter formatting and persistence
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Mail opens and responds correctly; attached item ownership preserved; save/reload and four-player mailboxes tested; no ghost or lost gifts.

Title: Holidays, calendar and culturally specific names
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Every original scheduled event has localized names and text; date, weekday, seasonal/weather branches tested against Japanese N64; untranslated holidays explicitly flagged.

Title: Catalog item IDs, item labels, and text-to-object maps
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Inventory/shop/gift/letter/item display use consistent labels; no wrong object due to reordered strings; invalid IDs show safe fallback in development builds.

Title: Intro, title, RTC, save, and uncommon paths
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Cold start, first day, all original valid failures and long-idle sessions tested; no Japanese fallback on reachable paths.

Title: Closed-loop translation QA and controlled batch workflow
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Rebuild manifests show exact modified IDs; script diffs independent of compiled ROM; duplicate strings resolved consistently; no unapproved translation master changes.

Title: Localization acceptance suite and release coverage
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Coverage report shows reachable IDs translated/verified, screenshot proof, no known P0/P1 localization regressions, and testable English version in a fresh four-human-resident town.

Title: Saplings die because a south-edge acre check reads a distant acre
Acceptance criteria: Verify/fix: locate acre-edge validity lookup; correct column argument, and check north/east/west boundary handling. Regression: edge and interior plots, legitimate blocked plots, town layouts with different acre arrangements.

Title: Light cherry-blossom weather never selected
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: change the referenced effect/condition if code confirms it; check April 4–8 and all snow/rain seasons. Do not assume that a GameCube seasonal table matches N64.

Title: Non-native orange fruit excluded by off-by-one RNG
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: select uniformly from a four-element list excluding the native fruit, rather than merely changing RANDOM(4) to RANDOM(5) (which could produce ID 5 after the existing increment). Preserve other fruit reward probabilities if intentional.

Title: Tortimer's 16th New Year's diary never awarded
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: adjust random bound to include all verified entries, then check all item IDs and distribution; test event after save/reload.

Title: Cockroach escape jump chooses one fixed, wrong direction
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: use a correctly bounded random Boolean/index; verify roach motion, collision and despawn.

Title: Snail flies away when the inventory is full
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: route automatic release through the snail's species-specific animation. Confirm snail availability in N64 before classifying N64 bug.

Title: Butterflies land only on white pansies
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: extend eligibility only after reviewing the table and behavioral design. If intentional, move to EX as a wildlife enhancement instead of an EN bug fix.

Title: Released arapaima has an oversized ground shadow
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: add the correct huge-fish shadow entry; confirm other fish classes and catch/release animation unaffected.

Title: Train audio attenuation wrong in a three-tier town
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: correct the vertical-coordinate reference or map-height conversion; check other positional audio sources and both layouts.

Title: Harvest Moon event uses incorrect precomputed dates
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: correct actual wrong entries or use a properly bounded computation. Protect the supported clock range, leap years and year rollover. Post-2030 support is a separate Enhanced feature, not an automatic bug-fix assumption.

Title: Axe durability changes when an interaction cancels the swing
Acceptance criteria: Expected: only a completed swing changes wear. Fix/regression: increment or commit wear only after animation/collision completion, or roll back on interaction cancellation; test tree hits, misses, hard-object hits, sign/door/menu interaction, reset, and counter limits. Keep intended base durability.

Title: Snowball/signboard interactions push the player outside valid collision bounds
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: enforce collision/position validation after scripted movement and before restoring movement; avoid overcorrecting legitimate snowball pushing. Link to downstream BUG-017.

Title: Opening the map while outside valid acres can crash
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: validate index in the map and fix underlying OOB movement; test negative coordinates, above-maximum indices, transitions, and legal borders.

Title: Diary message open/close on the same instant softlocks
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: serialize message state transitions, debounce duplicate events or enforce one ownership token per modal; test repeated and buffered input.

Title: Startup town-rating dump exemption
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: defer assessment until player town data/dump coordinates are initialized or pass the actual town state explicitly. Original N64 may not have this GC dump configuration; establish applicability first.

Title: Island coconuts never wash ashore
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: correct table length, verify coconut pickup/planting and shell quota. Decide explicitly whether coconuts should count as beach objects for cap logic (a separate gameplay policy), then test no-coconut recovery and full-beach conditions.

Title: Rain and morning aerobics disagree after map/clock changes
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Expected: weather and event schedule agree; no partially populated event. Fix/regression: use authoritative daily weather state when scheduling, not stale live-rendered weather; rerun event initialization consistently. Verify event actually exists in N64 and what its N64 cancellation rules are.

Title: Debt payoff and Spring Sports Fair event conflict
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: inspect scene transition, debt completion and storage/menu callbacks once exact conditions are identified. Do not treat the candidate sequence as a confirmed reproduction recipe.

Title: Igloo reward pool may produce dummy item
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: remove/replace invalid entry and update effective table length; preserve intentional souvenir behavior. If N64 has no igloo, target EX when added.

Title: Legacy paintings bypass special Blathers dialogue
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: make the two special legacy IDs eligible to reach the refusal handler, without marking them donatable normal paintings. Do not remove or replace original N64 paintings from EN as a bug fix; original N64 has no Blathers museum. If legally/distribution-relevant, handle art choices separately.

Title: Faraway fossil letter misses reburied discoveries
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town.

Title: Paper airplane prototype duplicates or locks player control
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: if not accessible in normal N64, do not add to EN. For EX, give airplane an explicit lifecycle, ownership/persistence rules, throw-state guard, cleanup callback, disallowed-action checks and complete render/interaction data. Never rely solely on assigning a random existing player state.

Title: Additional NES entry points to absent game data
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: reproduce a failing before case or identify the faulty source branch, patch it, confirm normal and edge paths on real N64, save/reload and return to town. Fix/regression: never dereference missing game data; only expose playable games with verified image/memory constraints. Additional games belong to EX/CONTENT-007, not automatic English restorations.

Title: Nook code gift is permanently unopenable
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: validate code-to-item mapping, wrapped-state flags and invalid item handling. Vanilla Japanese N64 has no North American Nook-code feature, so do not label as an N64 fix.

Title: Nook password/control-code interpreter can execute unintended code
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: strict input size/charset, index bounds, decoder state, checksum verification and defensive error return. Include fuzz/regression tests. Not in stock N64 unless a matching interpreter exists.

Title: Debug/cut collision object or golden cube duplicates in certain locations
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: resolve spawner/ownership only if content is made accessible. Catalog as cut/debug asset otherwise, not a shipping N64 bug.

Title: GameCube debug/beta objects use incompatible N64 texture references
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: document the correct renderer-to-texture mapping when porting/debugging content; do not transplant GC-specific renderer fixes into N64 code. If these objects remain unused, close as documentation only.

Title: Turnips can reportedly evade normal spoilage in rare setups
Acceptance criteria: Fix/regression: preserve intended turnip strategy and price randomness; prevent a demonstrated missed expiration transition without retroactively spoiling legitimate items or breaking clock changes.

Title: Conservative item stacking
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: A stack can split, transfer, sell, mail and survive reload without dupes.

Title: Multi-select pockets
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Cancel/confirm correctly; no ghost items or mismatched counts.

Title: Bulk sell, deposit and withdrawal
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Totals and bell balance exact, no lost items or double sale.

Title: Expanded organized home storage
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Four residents’ stores isolated; 100% item persistence in save/reload tests.

Title: Collection encyclopedia
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Lists are accurate, complete and do not unlock by invalid item ID.

Title: Detailed town map
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: No wrong markers in different generated layouts; proper acre bounds.

Title: Mailbox and draft management
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Repeated send/cancel/reload keeps attachment ownership; no wrong recipient.

Title: Blathers assesses fossils locally
Acceptance criteria: Definition of done: Dig, rebury, restart, assess, donate, check mail all work and flag occurs once.

Title: Better quest and collection feedback

Title: Faster repeat interactions

Title: Catchable whale with correct species text

Title: Shaki as a gardening visitor

Title: Water-bottle trash fish-up

Title: Recovered scared and purple-mist reactions

Title: Expanded holidays and seasonal events

Title: Golden tools and progression rewards
Acceptance criteria: Acceptance: Tool can be earned legitimately, used/saved correctly, with unlocks documented and no free unintended duplication.

Title: More home renovations/upgrades

Title: Improved town visuals with N64 art direction

Title: e+ style deep friendships, sickness and fleas

Title: After-hours Nook shop knock

Title: Reset Surveillance Center

Title: Additional title-theme and K.K. audio options

Title: Unused/gigaleak asset catalog and safe prototypes

Title: Controller Pak Famicom/Ice Climber compatibility
